tolerance.notes: Staggered B-spline interpolating regridder (RFC pure-io-data-loaders §8: 'B-spline: reproduction of the spline's polynomial degree exactly on staggered locations'). The golden F_tgt is an INDEPENDENT closed-form ORACLE — the test polynomial evaluated directly at the target locations — NOT the .esm. The reference binding feeds the host-derived kernel inputs (F_src = polynomial sampled at the uniform source nodes; base = stencil-start index; s = local coordinate) through the ESS engine (F_tgt[j] = Σ_k w_k(s[j])·F_src[base[j]+k], a static-unroll polynomial weighted sum) and must reproduce the polynomial exactly on the staggered targets (incl. the cell-face s=0.5 Arakawa-C point).

base_indexing: 1-based (ESS engine / Julia reference binding); a 0-based binding feeds base - 1
source_grid: uniform unit spacing h=1, node i at x = i (0-based node coordinate)

models.name: BSplineRegridLinear1D
models.notes: Degree-1 (linear); target at x=1.5 is the cell FACE (s=0.5, weights {1/2,1/2}).

models.name: BSplineRegridCubic1D
models.notes: Degree-3 (cubic); the centered 4-node stencil base..base+3, central interval [base+1, base+2]. Face weights are the 4th-order {-1/16, 9/16, 9/16, -1/16}.

models.name: BSplineRegridBilinear2D
models.notes: Degree-1 tensor product (bilinear), the staggered Arakawa-C case: P(x,y) = c00 + cx·x + cy·y + cxy·x·y, reproduced exactly.
